description: February 2, 2026 CINCINNATI, OH – On Monday, Greg Landsman (OH-01) demonstrated the strength and momentum of his campaign, announcing that he had raised more than $500K in Q4 and ending the year with nearly $1.5M cash on hand. Landsman’s total haul heading into the on-year is $1.8 million.&nb
